toast.restoreSummary: Restored. {{added}} added, {{updated}} updated, {{unchanged}} already up to date.

burn.mediaOnly: This note only contains media and can't be shared via burn link.

loadError.message: Could not load your notes. The local database connection was interrupted. This can happen after the app has been in the background for a while.

banner.proActivationPending: Payment received but Pro activation is taking longer than usual. Refresh in a minute, or contact support if it doesn't flip on.
banner.snapshotPaused: Note history is paused. Your Pro plan looks inactive. New edits won't be snapshotted until Pro is restored.
banner.storagePastDue: Your storage subscription payment failed. Update your card in Paddle to avoid losing extra capacity.

paneResize.hintCollapse: Click to collapse · Drag to resize

emptyEditor.uploadFiles: Or upload new files to your encrypted vault.
emptyEditor.selectNote: Select a note or create a new one.
emptyEditor.selectMarkdown: Open a Markdown file to read it here.

editor.titlePlaceholder: Untitled (click to edit or let it autogenerate)
editor.notBackedUpTooLarge: Over the 1 MB limit, so not backed up. Move pictures to attachments or split the note.
editor.notBackedUpFailed: Not backed up. Last error: {{message}}. Retrying.

share.currentHtmlDesc: Printer-friendly, markdown rendered on a white page.
share.printDesc: Opens the print dialog. Save as PDF or send to a printer.
share.burnDesc: Publish this note as a one-time view link. The link self-destructs after reading. Your note stays safe in your account.

settings.languageDesc: Choose the language PrivacyNotes is shown in.

importStore.title: Import or store?
importStore.bodySingle: {{filename}} looks like a markdown file. Import it as a note so you can read and edit it, or store it as an encrypted file attachment?
importStore.bodyMulti: These {{count}} files look like markdown. Import them as notes so you can read and edit them, or store them as encrypted file attachments?

bulkTrash.title: Move to Trash
bulkTrash.body_one: Move <highlight>{{count}} item</highlight> to trash? You can restore them later.
bulkTrash.body_other: Move <highlight>{{count}} items</highlight> to trash? You can restore them later.
bulkTrash.readOnlyBlocked_one: This item is <highlight>read-only</highlight>, so it cannot be moved to trash. Turn read-only off in the note options menu first.
bulkTrash.readOnlyBlocked_other: All <highlight>{{count}} items</highlight> are read-only, so none of them can be moved to trash. Turn read-only off in the note options menu first.
bulkTrash.readOnlySkipped_one: <highlight>{{count}} item</highlight> is read-only and stays where it is.
bulkTrash.readOnlySkipped_other: <highlight>{{count}} items</highlight> are read-only and stay where they are.

bulkDelete.body_one: Permanently delete <highlight>{{count}} note</highlight>? This cannot be undone.
bulkDelete.body_other: Permanently delete <highlight>{{count}} notes</highlight>? This cannot be undone.

tagConfirm.mergeBody_one: Tag <highlight>“{{targetTag}}”</highlight> already exists. Merge <highlight>{{count}} note</highlight> currently tagged “{{tag}}” into it?
tagConfirm.mergeBody_other: Tag <highlight>“{{targetTag}}”</highlight> already exists. Merge <highlight>{{count}} notes</highlight> currently tagged “{{tag}}” into it?
tagConfirm.deleteBody_one: Remove tag <highlight>“{{tag}}”</highlight> from <highlight>{{count}} note</highlight>? The notes themselves are not deleted.
tagConfirm.deleteBody_other: Remove tag <highlight>“{{tag}}”</highlight> from <highlight>{{count}} notes</highlight>? The notes themselves are not deleted.
tagConfirm.deleteWithNotesBody_one: Delete tag <highlight>“{{tag}}”</highlight> and move <highlight>{{count}} note</highlight> to Trash? You can restore them from there.
tagConfirm.deleteWithNotesBody_other: Delete tag <highlight>“{{tag}}”</highlight> and move <highlight>{{count}} notes</highlight> to Trash? You can restore them from there.

createNote.title: Create note?
createNote.body: No note titled <highlight>“{{title}}”</highlight> exists. This can happen if the linked note was renamed. Create a new note with this title?

freshVault.title: New vault created
freshVault.body: No existing vault matched the phrase you entered, so a new empty one was created. If you expected to see your notes, sign out and re-enter your phrase carefully - a single different word opens a different vault.

ambiguousLink.title: Two notes share that title
ambiguousLink.body: More than one note is titled <highlight>“{{title}}”</highlight>, so this link does not say which one it means. Rename one of them and the link will point at the other.
